description: Two gates that either pass a signal through or stop it, each opened by a gate voltage or by pulses, with one smoothing control shared by both to keep fast gating free of clicks

params.text: Chooses what opens that gate: with it on the GATE IN jack and button are used, with it off the pulses at TAP - TRIG IN are used
Switches that gate by hand while GATE MODE is off
Opens that gate by hand while GATE MODE is on
Sets the chance that a pulse at TAP - TRIG IN is acted on, from none of them to every one
Sets how gradually both gates open and shut
Resets that gate by hand, which arms it again once its one shot has been used
With it on that gate changes state only once and has to be reset before it will change again; a red lamp shows that the one change has been used

inputs.text: While GATE MODE is off, one pulse opens that gate and the next shuts it
A voltage added to the chance set by PROBABILITY on that gate
A voltage opens that gate while GATE MODE is on: under 1V the gate is shut, over 9V it is open
A pulse resets that gate, which arms it again once its one shot has been used
A pulse switches the one shot mode of that gate on
A pulse resets both gates at once

outputs.text: Carries the signal while that gate is open and 0V while it is shut; a green lamp lights while it is open

menu: Invert bridge mode — turns the logic of both gates around, so the signal is stopped while the gate is switched on
Return last value — holds a shut gate at the last voltage it passed rather than dropping it to 0V, which makes it a sample and hold
